short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Gardena.
local_note: Gardena homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Gardena's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Gardena, including Gardena proper, Moneta, South Bay adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Gardena?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Gardena building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Gardena?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Gardena rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Gardena remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
